policy: Authored before the search implementation existed. Each document page becomes one passage. A query counts as a hit when at least one expected (doc, page) is in the top 3 results; 'absent' lists passages that must not appear at all; 'none' queries must return nothing and must not error. English stemming is expected to bridge run/running, bake/baking and lentil/lentils; there is no synonym or semantic matching, so no query here relies on one.

documents.title: Q3 budget notes
pages: The finance team approved the budget for Project Marigold on 12 June. The total allocation is 40,000 dollars for marketing and travel.
Travel expenses must be submitted within thirty days. Receipts are required for every flight and hotel booking.
Marketing spend focuses on conference sponsorships and printed brochures.

documents.title: Lisbon trip
pages: We landed in Lisbon on Friday evening and took a tram to the hotel near Alfama.
On Saturday we visited the castle and ate grilled sardines at a small restaurant.
The flight home was delayed by two hours because of fog.

documents.title: Attention paper notes
pages: The Transformer architecture relies entirely on self-attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions.
Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces.
Training used the Adam optimizer with warmup steps and dropout regularization on the WMT 2014 English-German dataset.

documents.title: Meeting minutes
pages: Nadia chaired the quarterly planning workshop. Attendees agreed to move the kickoff meeting to next week.

documents.title: Health diary
pages: Started running three times a week and noticed better sleep. Doctor recommended more water and fewer late dinners.
Blood pressure readings were normal at the clinic checkup in March.
